user.title: GTFS Manager server
user.description: Enter the address of the GTFS Manager instance (e.g. {example}). Its /api/v1 endpoint will be used.

data_description.url: Without a scheme, HTTPS is assumed.

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: Which feed's stop would you like to add?

stop_search.title: Find a stop
stop_search.description: Feed: {feed}. Type the stop name (or code). Leave empty to list stops within {radius} m of your home.

stop.title: Choose the stop
stop.description: Platforms with the same name differ in routes and direction (→ terminus).

routes.title: Routes
routes.description:
Stop: {stop}

Select the lines (route + direction) you are interested in. If none is selected, all routes of the stop are included.

error.invalid_api: No GTFS Manager /api/v1 at this address (404) — wrong address, or the server runs an older version.
error.no_feeds: The server has no active feed.
error.redirect_other_host: The server redirects to a different host. Enter the final address directly.
error.maintenance: The server is under maintenance (e.g. updating). Try again in a few minutes.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests from this address. Try again in a minute.
error.http_error: The server returned an error (HTTP {status}). Try again later; details are in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This stop with these routes is already configured.
abort.invalid_selection: The selected item is no longer valid — please start over.

data.departures: Number of departures in the list

get_departures.name: Get departures
get_departures.description: Fresh departure list for a configured stop, with a spoken Hungarian sentence (speech), plus the delayed / cancelled departures and their sentence (delayed, delay_speech).
